body: Hardcoded magic numbers in `update_molt_stress` (shrimp.rs:480,493-497,502,504): the blend weights (0.5/0.3/0.2 for mineral stress components, 0.3/0.3/0.2/0.2/0.3 for stress pressure), and smoothing constants (rise=0.2, decay=0.05) are all hardcoded. These directly shape how mineral deficits translate into molt stress, which is a primary channel of the molt mechanics. Extract at least the rise/decay rates and the mineral-stress component weights into named parameters.
